findings.current: Though nothing he’d done in his life had been perfect justice, he had lived by true loyalty.
findings.defect: “Nothing he’d done” says none of his actions were perfectly just; the source concedes only that not every action was.
findings.rationale: 모든 일이 … 아니었을지라도 qualifies the whole of his record, not each individual deed.
findings.replacement: Though not everything he’d done had been perfectly just, he had lived his life true to his loyalty.
findings.source: 비록 지금껏 행한 모든 일이 완벽한 정의(正義)는 아니었을지라도, 진정한 충의(忠義)를 지키며 살아온 일평생이었으니.

findings.current: Toward a final stand in which their bodies would perish, but they themselves would remain immortal.
findings.defect: The draft makes the guards themselves immortal. The source says their final stand will endure.
findings.rationale: 불멸로 남을 modifies 최후, their end or final stand.
findings.replacement: Toward a final stand that would endure even after their mortal bodies perished.
findings.source: 비록 그 육신은 필멸(必滅)이나, 끝내는 불멸(不滅)로 남을 최후를 위해.

findings.current: Right up to the final moment, when a massive blood-red flash erupted without warning and swallowed everything around them.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the guards fall within the flash and substitutes an unsupported claim that it swallows everything around them.
findings.rationale: 파묻혀 스러지는 describes their deaths; 사방을 물들이는 describes the flash coloring the surroundings.
findings.replacement: Right up to their final moment, when they fell, engulfed by a massive blood-red flash that erupted without warning and stained everything around them.
findings.source: 불현듯 터져 나와 사방을 물들이는, 거대한 핏빛 섬광에 파묻혀 스러지는 그 마지막 순간까지도.

summary: The draft changes the extent of Jeong Hogun’s moral self-assessment and blurs what survives the guards’ final stand.
